## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest complete solution.

## Validation

List the manual checks you ran (see CONTRIBUTING.md's "Manual verification"
section) and their results. Note there's no automated test suite yet — a
manual walkthrough (ingest → query in the affected mode) is expected.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused (one logical concern per PR).
- [ ] What stays local vs. what's sent to the complex provider is unchanged,
      or the change is documented in README/DISCLAIMER.
- [ ] Affected documentation (`README.md`, env var table, project structure)
      is updated.
- [ ] No API keys, real documents, or extracted knowledge-graph content are
      included.
- [ ] Any submitted fixtures are synthetic or clearly redistributable.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under this project's
      MIT License.
